notes.title: Quick Dev update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/011de26242ebc10b4b25d2acf381b9a1bfefe184.jpg[/img]

Quick Dev Update for the Goose Lodge Bingo Hall. 

First off... I want to extend a warm welcome to all the new Islandville residents! We are honored to have you here enjoying some ticket redemption fun of the 90's with us! I really believe that 2025 is going to be the best year yet for The Coin Game. 

I have been busy finishing the Goose Lodge Bingo game content update and also working with a new team to upgrade the source project to a new version of Unity 2022. long story short... I underestimated the task of upgrading a 150GB project to a newer version of the Unity engine halfway through multiplayer development. Hey I'm learning here!

The current roadmap is to release this Goose Lodge update around the end of March. If all goes as planned, this March Goose Lodge update "should" be the last update with the old version of Unity (2018). The newer Unity (2022) version that myself and the team are currently working on in the background runs much better and has all but fixed the garbage collection "glitching" problems that we have been facing for years. We still have a couple months of work to do to convert all the other input systems and game saving systems to the new engine but Unity (2022) will be worth the wait. 

Enough about the boring stuff Kevin... where's the beef?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/c10d8b50ac2408b3ff51155448fa825ffce143dd.jpg[/img]

So... The next content update will focus on the inside of the Islandville Goose Lodge. It will include a complete Bingo Gaming hall where you can compete against the local Islandville Bots in a "professional" Bingo game. Keep track of your numbers called with an "ink dabber" and then scream BINGO when you have a row of 5 Dabs. It sounds pretty simple... but can get crazy fast. Stay focused and get lucky and you can walk away with some nice loot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/5d4cb63ff35bd273c3bdec4fce3391216152ac38.jpg[/img]

You will be able to play with multiple cards and have to be patient to beat the bots. I mean.. they are robots after all. I am working on a couple more small surprise machines in the Goose Lodge as well but we will have to wait to find out what those are. ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/840403410242fc37eff9f0225553bced3a715e1f.jpg[/img]

As I have said before I can't rush this process of upgrading the source project files. It must be done. The end quality of the game is just as important as adding shiny new features. So THANK YOU for being patient with me and my new team as we go back and fix dumb mistakes I made years ago building it.

That's about it for this small Dev News update. I will have even more info when the Goose Lodge Bingo hall comes out but I just wanted to touch base and let you all know a little more about the future roadmap. 

Thank you for your support of The Coin Game!

Kevin

notes.title: The Coin Game Fall content update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/abc7d3e79ea0777b00ce7ff123de1dbf35be10f6.jpg[/img]

Update #029 
Version: V0.9990
Build# 000000000


Greetings fellow Islandvillers! It's update time! This is the first update working with my new partners and all I can say is... So far. So Wonderful! They are showing me more opportunities for the game than I even knew existed. We are going to build great things together. That I know. I now have the ability to just work on the GAME. It's amazing. (I mean... I even have a teammate that checks my speling and grammer. I prob don't need it thuogh.) So BIG THANK YOU to the Kwalee team. Well Barry's in the background yelling at me right now "Enough suit talk junior... lets get to the gravy!". So here we go.

This update brings one new vehicle, a couple of new games, a couple of new locations, a programmable nanny bot and some good old fashion bug fixing. I made sure to spend some time fixing older bugs that were haunting players for years. I am really striving to make the game better and not just bigger. But hopefully there will be no more bicycles on the roof of Jerrys. I see players are exchanging strats in the discord on how to fetch their bikes from the roof. If you haven't checked out the discord I recommend it. Lots of fun and some great islandvillers in there. The Coin Game memes alone are worth it. 

This updates features:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/fbe432aad1ffcc527f8e5229b2a1bcd79d335764.jpg[/img]

- Nanny Bot is now programmable just like Stinky Jimmy the Junkman and Skippy the Scout newspaper bot. If you are playing survivor mode, the old bucket of bolts can be programmed to go shopping for you and Gary. You must have $20.00 in your ICU Savings account for the program to work. If you have the money, click on her yellow button on her back and she will "open up" with a key pad. Then you can enter the 4 digit code into the key pad and she will deliver the goods to your kitchen counter. She is not the fastest but she gets great deals from Jerry on items as they come from the same bot manufacturing plant. She will probably complain a little but she just doesn't like to be away from her Gary. If you program her and then go to sleep in survivor mode, she will have your goodies in the morning on the table. Remember that to program a "programmable" bot you simply click the back round yellow button on them and then click the key pad when it rotates out. Then you can enter the 4 digit code. It will give an error if you don't have the money in your savings or the code is entered wrong. The programmable bots rear LED will be green when in "default" mode and Nanny Bot will be purple when she is doing a job or in "program" mode. You can cancel a program with code 0000. I don't know why you would do that but I coded it in. lol. Just in case. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/88d124b7d8d60c2435ef8e93ecfc14379f633b1a.jpg[/img]

- I added a Used Family Mini Van for sale in Jerry's parking lot. $1800 is a steal for a unit like this. It's a little faster to travel around Islandville. It also has a few planned features which are not yet finished. The van will make cruising with friends possible in Multiplayer someday but for now it is just another option to cruise around with. It takes a little more gas but it is much faster than the bike or the golf kart. Make sure to check the gas gauge when you buy it... Jerry has been known to sell cars with little to no gas in them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/4e9e572ce9a7c626bd95b2ebb36ba50ed12cf1e2.jpg[/img]

- There is a radio in the Van (R key) or (Left D Pad) on controller to turn it on or off. For now, it's really simple and has no other features yet. It just plays the local radio and if you turn the radio on and off it will skip to the next song.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/dc5999b5a8edc358dba716ce9899a4bd4a4419b2.jpg[/img]

- New PAY LOAD Coin Dump game at the Mall Arcade. One of my favorite games in the real world. Inspired by the classic coin ramp game "Big Rig Truckin". Line up the ramp and time it just right to win big tickets. Get it in the bucket... 10 tickets. Hit the dump lever or through the bonus hoops and win BIG on just a single $1. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/ba2f71563813584d664867eef28f4214a216036b.jpg[/img]

- I added a shady "Shell Game" behind Barry's pawn shop. Who doesn't love a good street artist? Well I guess you could call it that. When the limo driver is not dragging Islandville brats around the town, he is making a little extra money behind Barry's pawn shop. You can wager some cash and if you pick the correct cup after he shuffles them up you will win double your money back. Make sure to keep your eye on the red ball... but it's kind of impossible as he is a robot and is faster than you think. Good luck. You are going to need it. Make sure to keep your head on a swivel so you don't get beat up by the bad bots while you are on their turf. Oh I almost forgot. For you big gamblers...you can also go ALL IN and risk it all for the ultimate double up. Make sure to have some back up cheesy poofs to get home though if things don't work out. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/b18efbbd8fa8b1cd0a6722debcec64b6320017f5.jpg[/img]

- Added more "construction" zones to the island to show some of the future building sites. The bots are always working in the background.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/bc0ab98ab07b3076d070d4d248d2936eeab5af24.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/011de26242ebc10b4b25d2acf381b9a1bfefe184.jpg[/img]

- Added Goose Lodge 377 at the main intersection. It will be open in the future for some fun "old school" games and more in the future. 

- Adjusted the , and . buttons that speed up and slow down the C "Free cam" for making better movies and pics.

- Added a reset Van button to the wrist watch map. It can still roll over in a bad crash so I am working on a "self righting" system for the future. For now, you can always use the reset van button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/3e4d9137541f59be44a2a4ff7d79c036c2957293.jpg[/img]

- Fixed the bug where the bike would disappear when you went into a building or when you left it under the awning at Jerrys Gas and Go. Bike is now "frozen" when you go inside any building. 

- Quieter Mega Drop Noise when Ball Drops. No more EREEEEEERRRRREEEEEEEEEEEEEGGGHGHGHHHHH screaming from the mega drop machine. Well, it still screams, but just not as loud.

- Removed the Red Cross markings from the game as it violated Article 38 of the Geneva Convention. Thanks to the Finnish Red Cross Volunteer for pointing that out to me. ;) 

- Adjusted Health and Energy on Pizza and Lemonade. A little bit of health increase instead of just energy. 

- Adjusted the Health and Energy from a nights rest in Survivor Mode. It no longer just sets the health to 99 and 65 energy. It will now just add +35 points of health and +50 energy to the players current levels. 

- Fixed the small percentage menu on the fish tank. When it says 100%, it would look like 10%.

- Fixed the "glitch" were you could insert an item into Barry's pawn shredder and get free loot. I loved all the piles of cash pics but it was bankrupting Barry. He said he is going to need that loot for his new Lambo wheels. Sorry.

- Fixed the display of Coins Balance in the watch stats menu. 

- Added the Coins Saved Balance to the wrist watch stats menu.

- Some other small optimization bugs for garbage collection.

So that's about it for this Fall update. For now I will be fixing bugs and doing small patches to adjust some parameters after I get more feedback from the update. After checking out the new update, make sure to check out all of our new socials that I am working on with Maddie. We have a Discord now, an official Facebook page, and more to come. As always a HUGE thank you to all of you for supporting this crazy project. Now I have to go win my money back from that lucky limo driver...

Don't forget to support you local arcade!

Kevin

notes.title: Dev Update & Publisher Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey Islandvillers. It's been a minute since I have posted a dev update. I am sorry about that and the lack of info but I had to wait until I had more news to bring you all up to speed on the changes happening behind the scenes here at The Coin Game.


You see... when I started this game 6 years ago I never would have suspected it would be this large and impactful. In the beginning, it was just a fun art project meant to play an old coin pusher from my local county fair as a kiddo. I then put it on Steam Greenlight and people voted it in pretty quickly. Here we are 6 years later and there is an entire island full of arcades, jobs and lots of silly bots. I never would have thought it would be this big and slowly over time I came to the reality that Uncle Phil and devotid would need some professional outside codesmiths to take this game to the next level.


So I decided around Mar/April of this year to buck up and seek outside partnerships and hire some smarter people than me. As a stubborn do-it-ALL-yourself kind of person that was very hard to face but the game is so much bigger than me now and it had to be done. It's taken months and lots of work to find the right help/partners for The Coin Game but I have found the right partners. Remember... I am a game developer, not a business suit, so this is something I have had to learn along the way.


Also...Side note. HUGE THANKS to Steam for building the Greenlight and Early Access programs and allowing me to build this title. Without the Steam Greenlight incubation system in place, I wouldn't have had the chance to even build this game. 


I can't say too much yet but it will bring The Coin Game to a new more professional level that it deserves. I have dropped the ball when it comes to the games "socials" and general interaction with the community. I am so busy coding, modeling and running the backend that it is near impossible to react to all the needs of the front end. So with this, I’m happy to announce that I’ve teamed up with UK-based publisher Kwalee!


This new team-up will help me with my day-to-day tasks while ensuring I have creative control and freedom over The Coin Game. The team over at Kwalee will be supporting me with marketing, production, and anything else in the future.
Together, we will improve the quality of life for the residents of Islandville! So, keep an eye out for more to come in the future.


Thank you for being patient during this time and thank you for supporting The Coin Game!


Kevin

notes.title: Dev Update: New Islandville Mall Work in Progress pics
notes.notes:
The Coin Game Dev Update:

First off I want to welcome all the new players and THANK you all for supporting The Coin Game! It has been a wonderful last few years and a dream come true to be able to build this game for you. We still have a long way to go though and I could not be more excited for the future of The Coin Game.

Its been a while since I have said anything on the next steps of The Coin Game. So lets get caught up. 

It saddens me to say but the multiplayer feature of the game is still on hold and going to take longer than I previously thought. So I have been finishing up more locations and new arcades in the mean time. I will share more info on the multiplayer delay when I have it. 

Here's what I am currently working on... 

(ALL PICS ARE WORK IN PROGRESS AND PRE LIGHTING/TEXTURING)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/40a9da6006b579a728aea4372f6e067c0722309a.jpg[/img]

Islandville is getting a MALL! That's right 100's of thousands of square feet of indoor shopping and loitering goodness! The coming Islandville Mall will feature many stores, funny new characters, a movie theater, a food court and a new "Arcade Castle" with new games and machines. The coming mall is inspired by 90-00's era shopping malls that are spread all around the US. This era was a time back when being "socially active" meant leaving the house to peacock around the local shopping center for "looks" and not "likes". Getting to play real arcade games as a kid was tough and it meant venturing out in to the great big world. You were risking it all on that crappy back tire of a borrowed neighbors sisters bike. But you took the chance an went for it. The mall was worth the ride...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/3131c1cda4790cc065fb38d387081b0677a3c791.jpg[/img]

The next arcade coming is influenced by the Alladin's Castle that was in my home town mall. I spent many days there. I would ride my bike 4-5 miles with friends and live off of hot pretzels and free ice water from the gracious clerk at the "gourmet" pretzel stand. Life was simple. The games were all pretty lame but we loved them. Maybe not as much as we loved shaving "steps: into the sides of our mullets but you get the idea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/80e7828f406768f68b974129954233ae2184fab2.jpg[/img]

Over the last couple months I have modeled all the "structure" and parking lots of the mall and working on fitting it into the current map of Islandville. When I get it done and release it, it will be the largest location on the entire island. I am currently in the unwrapping process and will be texturing the new models soon. I will release more pics of the mall when I get some textures on it. This stage of development is never really that beautiful or interesting so I find myself not sharing much.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/62890ab776a76d925ea13b7a0a22b5d46f294e19.jpg[/img] 

Overall the mall is huge. haha. I always seem to go a little bigger than I planned... but I think it pulls the best out of me. I only ask for patience and understanding of how big of a one man project this is. This is just a taste of the new stuff coming. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/603602ddbf0ea1930d0f69628df78a4b2c9f6ece.jpg[/img]

Here are a couple pics of some of the new machines coming to the next arcade. Can you guess them?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/96502f1f771a020825c4e221ce3d3bc2ee4ccae3.jpg[/img]

Also... I want to thank everyone for being understanding and patient as I am a one man dev. Yeah... I could hire more help but this is my sole creation and I enjoy the grind of working on it. I appreciate all the supporters and fans allowing me to present my "art project" to the world the way I see it. That means a lot to me. So again. Thank you.

This end of year holiday update brings new claw machines, new locations and even a new Pirate Pizza delivery job to earn more money around the island!

[h1]GENERAL NEWS[/h1]

[h2]Thank you very much for all the support of The Coin Game![/h2]

Also... WELCOME to all the new players of The Coin Game! We are honored to have you and are VERY Thankful that you chose The Coin Game. Here at devotid... we take wasting your time very seriously. ;)

I have been working quietly in the background on this new update for a couple months (ok... more like 6 months). I am really glad to finally have it completed as my wife and I went through a large move over the last 5 months. We also had two very old Weiner doggies (16 and 17) that we spent precious last months with at our new home. If you are passionate about games... Look into the wonderful community that Unity game engine has to offer. I could barely turn a computer on when I started this journey. Now I am more excited. Dec 22nd 2021

Version: V0.9943

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/559e80e7c53912f89b73e25f8377edeef7ffde7f.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Radio Controlled Sailboats:[/h2]
One Eye'd Billies still had open area in the back... so I finished up the Radio Control Boat pond. Players can now earn tickets by piloting a wooden radio controlled sailboat around the pond and collect life rafts worth 50 tickets each. There is a time limit so be sure to hurry through all of the sea going traffic. If you get the minimum number of rings you will earn a 500 ticket bonus on top of your score.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/62aa01b76f1328975730627d5a2d6d5a70781ea6.jpg[/img]

This is a small replica of the old Radio Controlled boats from Cedar Point in Sandusky, Ohio. I had a blast playing with these as a child and would look forward to them all year. The boats were removed in the 90's and was VERY hard to find any pictures of info on them. The entire machine was modeled and built from one single old photo I found online. I hope it brings back great memories for others or makes new ones for those that couldn't be there. 




[h2]New Pizza delivery Job:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/d59e6cad9c14a2e18250c9b5ee640616bbb33d80.jpg[/img]

Now you can earn money delivering food to hungry islanders. Who didnt love delivering pizza pizzas as a job? Being your own boss... The open road... Pure freedom. The process is pretty simple. You buy pizzas with your own money. Put them into your inventory. Then just drop the pizza into the delivery box at each location with a light on the porch and also receive tip if you are fast enough. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/4edec765c0a062a205a8908b3208d51036d644f6.jpg[/img]

summary: Purchase pizzas from the Pirate Pizza outdoor vending machine at One Eye'd Billies. Then you will see a countdown timer and a place appear on your watches mini map and also on the top left of the screen in red. Deliver any Pirate Pizza that you have to the location before the timer runs out to get paid, if you hurry you will get a nice tip from the local islanders. These delivery pizzas are not the ones from inside One Eyed Billies that you eat. Those are different and not packaged for delivery. You can not eat the delivery pizzas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/9dae814c4ec7860aa283ab4daf9a4306b966c99d.jpg[/img]

If you dont make it in time you can always sell the old pizzas to Barrys Pawn Shop for a little cash. There is a dozen locations spread around the map to deliver to. There is even a new subdivision out by the UFO arcade with 3-4 new houses. Good luck Matey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/4caeefa866b7a4ccec6a20ac1172690f99686cf4.jpg[/img]



[h2]NEW GAMES at One Eye'd Billies:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/c124945272566aa1ffd8553e6ce0171b5f15344a.jpg[/img]
- "Fishy fishy" is a regular style of claw machine that gives stuffed animals you can collect or trade for loot at Barrys. It works just like Dude Where's My Cow?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/1f6c1a04976af627431538f3f6fcc42637923e04.jpg[/img]
- "Cash Claw" is a new scoop style claw machine (more of a crane bucket) that you attempt to scoop up cash and small prizes that are worth different amounts of money. If you win prizes in this machine the game will automatically add the money right to the players wallet and does not have to be "picked up" like other claw machines. This new machine is a work in progress and needs a little more optimization. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/ebb0c6460032b516aaf35a78b32e54db93a64a3d.jpg[/img]
- "MegaDrop EXTREME!" It deserves ALL CAPS... because it is huge! Its is a similar version to the very popular Mega Drop that is currently at Larrrys Arcade but just way way bigger. Complete with the same catchy music. haha. Lets see those leaderboard scores... only bigger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/1893192ad892311376564da1e7f14e5f330a9ec3.jpg[/img]

- Moved a copy of the Pinball Machine and the Snow Ball Battle Arcade Game to One Eye'd Billies, It wasnt getting much play at the Dollar Store. Let me know what you all think. The pinball game has not been optimized yet for One Eye's Billie's and may be a little slow on frame rate. I get about 50-60 on a GTX2060/ i7. I have to add a few more controllers to OEB to finalize the install of it... but I thought I would sneak it in there for the Holidays. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/c52989f8f39a96ea8e8def75905cabcb45363d9a.jpg[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/699443949b35fe31c6b6ec76f5fba3822df7fe59.jpg[/img]
MISC updates and bug fixes:
- Added new audio for One Eye'd Billies prize counter character. YARRRRRGGGGHHHH!
- Added new audio for UFO arcade Price counter character. Space robots...
- Updated the Mini Map to show the recent locations and new subdivisions.
- Adjusted the mini map "zoom" to move farther away from the player to look around the map more. Currently you could not see the edges of the map when moving around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/506c3d17525352be4be381996d3e4c55ea9d509b.jpg[/img]

- Added the onscreen GPS to the Bike to help delivering stuff to the destinations. Hit the "Tab" key on the keyboard or the watch button on the controller to view it while riding. 
- Fixed the Mini Map Player Icon from Wandering around on the mini map. It works a little more precise now. It also works a little better when in a cart or on a bike.

- Fixed a bunch of the leaderboards not recording data.

That about does it for this surprise holiday update. I have a few more things I wanted to get into this update but I have taken long enough finishing up One Eye'd Billies. I am still working on the Co-op/Multiplayer, more optimizations and a BUNCH cool new areas and games coming to Islandville throughout 2022.

Thank you all again. Have a MERRY CHRISTMAS from devotid. 

Kevin

notes.title: New update coming next week! Teaser pics included. Price increase.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/6d5bdde411355310b6d1496e074d20e87cb5f553.jpg[/img]

Hello Islandvillers! 

[h3]REMEMBER THIS IS NOT RELEASED YET AND IS JUST A TEASER. COMING NEXT WEEK![/h3]

I have been finishing up One Eye'd Billies and thought I would stop to show a few pics of the new machines and also talk about the price increase of the game coming next week. The next update to The Coin Game will feature three new arcade machines, two new shooting galleries and two extra little features. Oh and lots of bugs fixes, a FOV slider and some fixed achievements all coming next week. 

After reading through all of the discussions and suggestion threads I came up with these next arcade machines.

[h3]The first machine is Combo Craze.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/812fa24b250e586542f26d64203ca0cd3670789b.jpg[/img]

It is a game of skill were you must stop the rotating line on the dot to crack the combination 50 times in a row. The increasing speed and rotating angles are a fun challenge to get just right. I really enjoy games at the arcade that are "mostly" skill based. They are also the easiest to code too as there are no algorithms to fandangle and tweak.

[h3]The second machine is Popcorn Petes Pirate Plunder.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/4c890cf447cd1ff13fb876edbeb9fd7109ce1a73.jpg[/img]

Everyone loves Popcorn Pete! This new machine is a "plinko" style ball drop game. Press the button to fire a canon ball from the "SS Popcorn" and land in a treasure chest of tickets. It features a translucent LCD screen overlaid on the cabinets glass to give cool celebration graphics and counting screens. There is a center target that has a increasing bonus to win. Try your luck on the Popcorn Pete's Pirate Plunder game and win a boat load of tickets!

[h3]The third new arcade game coming in the next update is Pile Up.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/4b19b49ecb022aab42886799127002b96b54fb1c.jpg[/img]

Pile Up is a stacking blocks kind of game. There is a left to right sliding handle on the front of the machine to move the base platform. When the blocks fall from the top you simply need to stack them up to the ticket winning lines. Seems easy right? Just wait until the stack gets a little taller... and then TIMBER!!!! 

I really cant wait to see all the new videos and streams of people saying.... "Just one more". Haha. After an update I usually spend a day watching streamers and gathering feedback. I dont know how many times I have heard "If the dev is watching this <insert advice here>" and I think to myself "ok write this down. That's a great idea." 

For example... about a month ago I was watching a user play the game on Twitch and he was babysitting. He lost the mop through the wall and could not finish the task. He proceeded to click on the box of floor wipes on the ground next to the mops original position as it was the most logical thing to do to bring the mop back. So after watching this. I have since added that feature to the next update. Because it was a great idea. So thanks to him the game is now better for all of us (Well next week it will be.... but you get what I mean.) This is just one example but I have used many streamers suggestions and really appreciate you sharing your feedback.

As always feel free to give feedback in the discussion areas. I do my best to read them all as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/e87e660d240b5f19ec5ceb20ed13a4fe5e60b21f.jpg[/img]

When I built One Eye'd Billies I left an area for "Captains Quarters Shootin Gallery" on the right when you come in. At the time of modeling and building it I didnt know what I was going to put in there. I knew I wanted a "roadside" shooting gallery somewhere in the game like you see on the interstates of America but I didnt know if it would fit in the theme of Captains Quarters. Well I just went for it. I started modeling funny things that I remembered from Cedar Point shooting galleries (Google It). I believe they called it Frontier Town or something like that. It was really fun and I remembered it for many years growing up. When I was modeling I found only one single horrible quality video. It worked though. So thank you to that guy that lugged that 10 lbs VHS camera all around the park that day and got that valuable vintage footage for us. :)

[h3]Roadside Shootin Gallery[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/7b956dd49e92bd270e9a338a5107948c49b0824d.jpg[/img]

The new shooting galleries at One Eye'd Billie's has two sides. On the left is the "Fun" shooting gallery that will issue tickets for hitting the small targets near each "feature". The rifles use a laser light and use no real ammo. There is a spinning water wheel of chance and plenty more silly reactions to shoot at. You get a total of 15 shots for each round and there is no time limit. 

[h3]Clay Pigeon Skeet Shoot[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/52ee86fb470b6a1bede3c2deaf8e2b2c6729eae8.jpg[/img]

The Skeet Shoot on the right is a timed game of shooting skill with fun pellet guns and clay pigeons. You will get a specified amount of time and unlimited shots to hit as many targets as possible. For now all of the pigeons are the same value. If you hit more that 42 targets you get a 500 ticket bonus. 

This is a kind of version 1.0 and I have plans to expand on this later in development. 


Here are a couple of small extras that I will be releasing next week in the new update. 

[h3]Quickplay Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/1e86b2873e83ce0b99d7eaa3d8857822b23eb8dd.jpg[/img]

Added a Quickplay Mode. What is quickplay mode you ask? Quickplay Mode is a simple way to dip into the world quickly and just play the game that you want without venturing to the island and dodging bots and buses. It is just the chosen game in a empty gray room for now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/d8fa08ddc0178d746ee700b67a475ff503e8ef6d.jpg[/img]

I have been working on multiplayer mode and need to work on each machine individually. I need to cycle through many machines quickly as I add features to them. Well until now, I didnt have all the machines in one place and needed to do just that for future development work. So I made a simple way for me to play each machine quickly and without having to load the entire island. So when I got done with the system the other day I thought to myself that maybe players would like a way to just play the games without all of the other stuff sometimes. So here it is. Quickplay mode. I think I am going to make a menu that will allow the player to choose to start the mode with 5, 10, 25, 50 or 100 bucks. That way users can challenge a friend to see who gets more tickets with X amount of $. I may expand on this in the future but for now it is what it is. A single arcade machine in a room that should load a bit faster and get a little more FPS on some of the lower end computers.

Let me know what you all think.


[h3]Prize Loot Crates[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/f1554f58ad0546ce0065f487ceb7608296c2bcdb.jpg[/img]

I have added 20 fun loot crates around the island for the next update coming next week. A kind of challenge to get out in the great outdoors and explore! When you find one....click on it to open it. It will have 3 random prizes in them that are yours to keep. 

These will be used in the future for other things and challenges and I wanted to get a little feedback on them.




[h3]The price of The Coin Game will increase next week to $13.99 USD. So get it now whiles it's cheap! [/h3]

Here is a picture of the original concept for The Coin Game. It was originally called Push Stuff. Here is the original Steam Greenlight Link from 2015. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=568690459

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/536cad441032b63618c6abfb3c7ac94010ac0f5f.jpg[/img]


When the coin game was released in Feb 2019 it featured about a dozen games in one location. Now two years later the game features 3 full arcades, over 50 games and ticket machines, 15 unique locations with multiple money earning jobs. Along with a multiplayer planned for the future.

So my wife and I thank you all from the bottom of our hearts for giving us the ability to build this title for you. I read all of the comments, suggestions and discussions and seeing some of the folks enjoying the nostalgia and environment of a small town really makes the feels flow. :)

So that's about it for this little teaser. Look out for the update next week.

Kevin

Version: V0.9941

Now when you hover on an applicable chair, a cursor will show a sitting image. Left Click or the interact button on controller to sit down. Then when you want to stand up again just hit the the Exit "vehicle" button or the E Key. When you are at home or at the babysitters the TV Remote will be in your right hand. Ball/Marble Coin Style pusher with bonus wheel and Ice Ball Ramp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/8a29bfae77607a49b9e4eb4357165d7efa66e6f0.jpg[/img]

I hope you all enjoy it! Let me know in the comments what you think. 

After the Christmas break I will be continuing work on the rest of the machines for One Eye'd Billies, RC Boat game and the Shooting Gallery. Thank you for all the support for The Coin Game!

Happy Holidays!

Kevin

notes.title: Damage System Patch: Fixes and adjustments to Damage, Health and Energy systems
notes.notes:
Aug 11th 2020

Update #021 
Version: V0.994
Build# 5400544

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/e668be2df924a7985ee5190ae8f917dc878442c4.jpg[/img]

[h3]UPDATE SUMMARY:[/h3]
This update mainly addresses the "insta-death" from the bad bots or a random goose food item to the head. I have been watching many of your hilarious streams over the last few weeks and have seen way too many insta-deaths. I have made some changes to the way damage is dealt to the player and also at what times. Now the most damage you can get from an whipping item is about a 1/10th of what it was before. I turned all of the damage down on those items. This should eliminate the insta-deaths from holding items or falling down a hill and receiving a -50 damage. Now you will receive at the most a -10 Damage when falling off of a roof. Getting hit by a car will still kill you... so dont hang out in the road. In one of the future updates I plan on including damage when you are on the bike and Golf Cart. So start getting used to watching out more for traffic. 

Congrats to all of you veterans that played and LIVED through these rough and barbaric early times here on Islandville Isle. Well done. 

I made the bad bots "Short Circuit and burn up" now when you shoot them 3 times with a rubber band gun or even the Roman Candles. Shooting them 3 times will short circuit the bad bots and make them run to Larry's back door by the lambo to "heal up". This will give you more time to get to Barry's front door and be a little more "in control" around the pawn shop. I still have plans to add more "weapons" to battle them and also better "burning up" animations for the bad guys but that will come at a later date. ;)

I also turned down the "constant declining health" system a bit. Now your health will only drop quickly if you are really low on energy. I am still working on a "low energy and health" visual warning system that will come in the next phase of Survivor Mode beta.

You can also check in to go to bed 2 hours earlier now. 7 PM instead of 9 PM the blankets in your bed will now be open. This should also ease the health drain a bit and allow you to get some rest a little bit earlier and refresh yourself.

I am still working on a Dev blog with some early teasers for the next location. One Eye'd Billies Fun and Adventure Center. I will have the blog post ready very soon with a little road map for some of the coming games and even some ideas for future development. So stay tuned.

That's about all I have for this small patch update. You may notice a couple more small patch updates coming to keep adjusting the new beta Survivor Mode. 

Thank you to all of you for all the support. I could not do this without ALL OF YOU!

Kevin


[h1]UPDATE PATCH NOTES:[/h1]

[h3]DAMAGE SYSTEM:[/h3]
- Turned off the player damage system when using the Karting System and Lazer Tag systems.
- Turned off the player damage system when you are holding an item to stop the killing yourself when trying to feed Gary/Fish or manipulate other things.
- Turned down the health damage received from all items and also the health damage from falling off of higher areas. 

Old Values
 -50 = High Damage
 -25 = Med Damage
 -5 = Low Damage) 

New Values
 -10 = High Damage
 -5 = Med Damage
 -2 = Low Damage

- Reduced the amount health that will be subtracted throughout the day. Now only when you are really really tired will it start to decrease a drastic amount. Turned down about 25%
- Deactivate the bikes wheel colliders sooner to stop the bikes wheels from interfering with the player controller and sending you to the moon. 


[h3]CURFEW:[/h3]
- You can now check in 2 hours earlier and go to sleep to get that needed boost of health. The bed "covers" will open at 7 PM instead of 9 PM now.


[h3]BARRYS:[/h3]
- Fixed a bug in Barry's that would allow the player to eat an item and still get paid for it. Now the menu and system will auto update when changed.
- Fixed a bug with the Barry's "Hot item" System not displaying the proper names.
- Fixed a bug with Barry's not paying double on some of the "Hot Items".
- Rebuilt the bad bots and how they respond to being shot. You can also now "stop" them with fireworks. Hit them three times to make them "retreat".
- Added more locations for the "bad bots" to randomly visit around Barry's area to help spread out the "presence" of them at the front door of Barry's.
- Fireworks can damage the bad bots and deactivate them for about 30 seconds as they are "burning up". (Work In Progress)
- Rubber bands can damage the bad bots and deactivate them for about 30 seconds as they are "burning up". (Work In Progress)



[h3]MISC:[/h3]
- Changed the way the Carnie Pool Ducks are loaded at the carnival. Ducks were slowly disappearing after a bunch of plays and locking the player in the game after they were all gone.
- Fixed some Random Items that were not spawning on the Dollar store roof. 
- Added the Mountain Bike to the help menu. H Key at anytime will open the help menu.
- Removed and tweaked a bunch of Nanny Bots house hang out destinations. Now she wont be annoying and in the kitchen all the time messing up you and Gary's chow time.
- Removed the manual time simulation "sun mover system" when you are on "Manual Time Mode". Saves a little GPU Load and stops the shadows from flicking and moving as much. When the time is progressing through the day the shadows will move all the time and can get annoying. 
- Fixed the "H Key" Help Menu that was not working on all resolutions.

I have finished a new 64 bit version of The Coin Game. This should use a bunch more of that Memory and Ram you paid good money for. I also whipped up a new first draft of a "Free Camera" mode (C Key) that will allow you to fly around the island with a just a simple camera. Thanks CaptainSauce for the idea. It is great for taking screenshots and getting those tough angles in videos. It is similar to how a Spectator Camera works in a multiplayer game. It will NOT move the player and only the Free Camera. You can rotate the camera with the mouse. The WASD keys for now will pan the camera Forward/ Backward Left and Right. You can change the speed of camera pan with the comma and period (,.) keys (Min 0.5 - max 10). You will see the speed of the pan in the lower left of the screen on the Free Camera Menu. It Opens and Closes when you hit the C Key. Holding the Shift key will turbo the pan speed X 10 times. You can hide the "free camera" menu for screenshots by clicking the little hide button. You can lock the camera to the X and Z Axis (it locks the Y height) by holding the Space Bar.

notes.title: Update for Q 2019 Release Date for The Coin Game.
notes.notes:
[h1]Update on Release Date[/h1]
In typical devotid fashion I have gone way overboard and added a ton of stuff. The problem is that with only one person working on a title of this size is that things take way longer than ever expected. Now that I have finished and filled the first arcade, I can start to get more beta testers in the mix and get the Early Access version out to patiently waiting users very soon ;) I had to move the release date to Q1 2019 as I have changed the overall vision of the game and added some different modes. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32533218/1fb53b72d35423730baac9754c4b046d17f0ea5b.jpg[/img]

Here is a quick teaser of the characters available in The Coin Game. 
https://youtu.be/2n1918Jo1FE
I am essentially building two games now. 

[h1]Birthday Mode: [/h1]
A standard Arcade "simulator" where you can just enjoy playing the arcade games and getting prizes without the worry of earning money and having to eat/drink to keep your health up. This is just a fun stress free way to enjoy a night of ticket hunting. You can even teleport instantly around the island from the map menu on your smart watch. (if you are outside). No curfew, No hunger and no mom texting you all the time. Just pure prize winning freedom all granted to you by your rich unlce Phil.

[h1]Survival Mode: [/h1]
Then there is another mode where you start with nothing and have to earn money doing jobs and scavenging things around the island town to continue progressing and winning prizes. There is a daily paper route to deliver newspapers to a dozen spots around the island. Each paper you deliver will earn you a couple bucks. You also get a bonus tip for delivering all 12 papers to all the red newspaper boxes around the island. The newspaper spots are marked with a small mailbox on your smart watch menu and will turn green when you have already delivered to that location for the day. You can walk, run or take the bus to get to all 12 delivery locations or the real paperboys get themselves a used golf cart from Barry's pawn and swap.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32533218/390b3e4ebb01c64bba3369f816d915502eed2413.jpg[/img] 


Here is another quick teaser of the characters available in The Coin Game with a new menu.
https://youtu.be/SCjmG46dSuI
Everyday before midnight you will have to check in with your mom and then go to sleep. This will complete a full day. The next day more jobs will be available again to earn more money. This mode is still in development and will be evolving throughout the early access version. Lots of fun and exciting things are coming for the world's first Arcade Survival Game. Yeah I totally just made that genre up. 

Having the two different modes will give users the chance to enjoy the game in any way that they like.
